author: claude-code

conventions.view: Same as Bitglow LRK: top-down 3/4 (front face visible, top surface foreshortened), light from upper-left, 1 px dark-brown outline (#3a2418 family), no anti-aliasing, hard alpha (0 or 255 only), transparent background.
conventions.pixel_density: Native 16-px grid identical to Bitglow LRK sheets. Engine displays at 2x, so in_game_px = native_px * 2 (world px). Do NOT pre-scale deliveries; deliver native.
conventions.palette: Bitglow LRK warm palette as the base (cream walls, walnut and light oak wood, sage cabinet green). Room accents: entrance mustard #d9a441, hall sage #8fae7a, archive deep green #3f5f4a with brass #c9a24a, nursery terracotta #c8714a with fresh green #7fbf5a. Seed packet faces may use brighter saturated colours; they are the shop's colour source.
conventions.character_reference: Xiaojingyu ~75 world px tall (~37 native px); Tuantuan 60 world px. Table tops should sit at ~ the character's waist (~26-30 native px from floor to top edge for counters, ~20 for low tables).
conventions.anchor: anchor_px is in native pixels from the sprite's top-left, marking the floor contact point used for y-sort (usually bottom-centre of the base). Wall-mounted items: anchor = the bottom-centre where the object meets the wall base line.
conventions.footprint: collision_footprint_world is width x depth in world px, centred on the anchor and extending upward (north) from it. 0x0 = no collision.
conventions.text: No baked text. Leave blank sign faces; the engine renders Chinese text on top. Give the blank face rect in the manifest (text_rect_px).
conventions.delivery: PNG per object (or per variant strip, frames left-to-right, equal cell size) under seedshop-study/art/codex/<id>/. Record in ASSET_MANIFEST.json: id, path, native size, cell size if strip, anchor_px, footprint, variants, text_rect_px, source (existing sheet+rect or imagegen), licence note.
conventions.resolve_existing_first: Before generating, check bitglow/*_LRK.png. If a fitting sprite exists, mark resolved_existing with sheet + rect instead of generating.
